definitions.gloss: passionate singing; singing with intense emotion
definitions.explanation: Singing with great passion and emotional intensity. Often used to describe powerful vocal performances at concerts, karaoke, or on music programs.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{熱唱|ねっしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バラード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熱唱|ねっしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She sang the ballad with great passion.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{代表曲|だいひょうきょく}→代表曲：24183_daihyoukyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熱唱|ねっしょう}し、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}いに→大いに：01609_ooini⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the concert, the artist passionately sang their signature song and the venue erupted in excitement.

notes: Composed of ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, passion) + {唱|しょう} (chant, sing). Describes singing with emotional intensity and passion — not just technical skill. Common collocations: {熱唱|ねっしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sing passionately), {熱唱|ねっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧ (to give a passionate singing performance). Frequently used in entertainment news and music show commentary. Part of the {熱〜|ねつ〜} family expressing intensity: {熱演|ねつえん} (impassioned performance), ⟦{熱弁|ねつべん}→熱弁：13482_netsuben⟧ (impassioned speech), ⟦{熱戦|ねっせん}→熱戦：21496_nessen⟧ (heated match/contest).
